name: Measure-Theoretic Bottleneck Obfuscation
description: Replaces explicit sum and addition conditions with equivalent properties of interval sets. `JOB i` is framed as the minimum scalar distance between endpoints, and `LOAD c` as the total measure of the union of disjoint intervals. This forces the model to mathematically deduce that minimum distance = p1+p2 and measure of union = sum(p) rather than pattern-matching the relaxed scenarios.
